title: Petra and the Bell
author: Wren Halloran
blurb: Noor Whitlock, a property surveyor appraising a house that appraises back, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. Then every mirror in the house starts reflecting the room one second late — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must finish the ritual the founders started before the well refills.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
